sentiment.rationale: The document reports a solid Q4 with comparable sales up 1.3% and adjusted EPS up 2.6% year-over-year, but forward guidance for FY2026 is cautious: total sales guidance of $92-94B (implying ~7-9% growth, largely from acquisitions) and comparable sales flat to up 2%, with management explicitly stating 'our outlook for 2026 remains cautious given the persistent volatility in housing macro.' The guidance range is wider than historical norms, reflecting uncertainty, and management flags continued pressure on big-ticket DIY and elevated mortgage rates. The forward outlook is not raised relative to prior expectations; it is held with a cautious tone, resulting in a slightly negative score.

summary.revenue: Q4 2025 sales were $20.6 billion, comparable sales increased 1.3%. Full year FY2025 sales were $86.3 billion, comparable sales up 0.2%.
summary.eps: Q4 2025 GAAP diluted EPS of $1.78; adjusted diluted EPS of $1.98, a 2.6% increase over prior year adjusted diluted EPS. Full year FY2025 adjusted diluted EPS of $12.28, a 2% increase over prior year.
summary.guidance: FY2026 outlook: total sales $92.0 to $94.0 billion (7-9% increase vs prior year), comparable sales flat to up 2%, operating margin 11.2%-11.4%, adjusted operating margin 11.6%-11.8%, diluted EPS $11.75-$12.25, adjusted diluted EPS $12.25-$12.75.
summary.margin: Q4 2025 adjusted gross margin 32.7%, down 18 bps; adjusted SG&A 21.4% of sales, de-leveraging 37 bps; adjusted operating margin 9%, down 41 bps. Full year FY2025 adjusted operating margin 12.1%, flat to prior year excluding acquisitions.
key_risks: Persistent volatility in housing macro and elevated mortgage rates pressuring big-ticket discretionary DIY projects.
Uncertainty around tariff policy and its impact on costs and pricing.
Consumer confidence remains subdued due to inflationary pressures and economic uncertainty.
Lock-in effect keeping housing turnover and new home starts under pressure.
Unclear how much of tax refunds will be spent on home improvement.
Q1 2026 comp sales expected to be below the midpoint of full year guide due to severe winter storm activity in February.
key_opportunities: Pro business growth driven by expanded salesforce, Pro Extended Aisle, and new AI-enabled Pro Companion.
Online sales growth of 10.5% in Q4, with record Black Friday/Cyber Monday and strong app engagement.
Home services high single-digit growth, with improved digital tools and installation solutions.
Acquisitions of FBM and ADG expected to be accretive to adjusted EPS in FY2026, with cross-selling and synergy opportunities.
Structural demand drivers: home equity at record levels, aging housing stock (average 44 years), and need for ~16 million new homes over next decade.
Lowe's Media Network and loyalty program (MyLowe's Rewards with 30M+ members) driving supplier partnerships and customer engagement.

management_tone.label: cautious
management_tone.justification: Management repeatedly uses phrases like 'our outlook for 2026 remains cautious given the persistent volatility in housing macro' and 'we are cautiously optimistic just because there's lots of uncertainty out there,' indicating a guarded forward stance despite solid Q4 results.
